decisions.decision: dateFormat.test.ts uses a noon-UTC fixed timestamp (2026-01-07T12:00:00Z), not midnight-UTC
decisions.rationale: A midnight-UTC date string renders as the previous calendar day when Intl.DateTimeFormat formats in a negative-offset local timezone (confirmed: America/Denver, UTC-7, renders 2026-01-07 midnight-UTC as 'Jan 06, 2026'), while GitHub Actions runners default to UTC — this would have made the test pass locally but fail in CI, or vice versa. Noon UTC is safe across any realistic timezone.
